# Firepush

> Firepush is a multi-channel marketing automation platform for Shopify stores, specializing in web push notifications, SMS marketing, and abandoned cart recovery.

Firepush helps ecommerce merchants drive conversions through push notifications, SMS campaigns, and omnichannel retargeting strategies. The platform integrates with Shopify and Shopify Plus, offering TCPA-compliant messaging solutions with support for major browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, and Opera.

## Key Topics

- Push notifications
- SMS marketing
- Shopify integration
- Abandoned cart recovery
- Marketing automation
- Conversion optimization
- TCPA compliance
- Browser support (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
- Shopify Plus
- Web push notifications
- Delivery notifications
- Omnichannel retargeting
- Ecommerce marketing
- App integrations (Loox)
- Mobile marketing (iOS)
